stories.title: Follow live: Jacardia Wright's TD pads Seahawks' lead
TE to go from Browns to LSU in historic twist
stories.summary: The Browns are waiving tight end Dae'Quan Wright, who has an agreement in place for the 2026 season to play for LSU if he clears waivers, agents Drew Rosenhaus and Kyle Lincoln told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Kanter Freedom tossed after clash with Cloud
stories.summary: Ex-NBA player Enes Kanter Freedom was ejected from Sunday's game between the Fever and the Sky after a verbal altercation with Chicago's Natasha Cloud.

stories.title: Monken: Watson comments not factor in QB call
stories.summary: Browns coach Todd Monken said that he anticipates naming a starting quarterback Monday and that Deshaun Watson's postgame comments Saturday won't factor into his decision.

stories.title: Jeanty helped off with apparent right knee injury
stories.summary: Raiders running back Ashton Jeanty left Sunday's training camp practice early after suffering an apparent right knee injury.
